record.question: As per ___________of the Mizo Marriage Divorce and Inheritance of property act 2014, If the testator executes more than one will for the same property, the latter or last one will prevail over the other or others.
record.explanation: Section 29 of the Mizo Marriage, Divorce and Inheritance of Property Act, 2014 (Act 9 of 2014) deals with wills; sub-section (2) reads: "If the testator executes more than one will for the same property, the latter or last one will prevail over the other or others." This matches the printed question at page 8 of Paper-III MCS (Departmental) December 2025 verbatim, so the blank is filled by section 29 (2). Sub-section (1) is about the formalities of executing a will, (3) about wills induced by coercion/fraud being void, and (4) about the qualification of witnesses.
